rows.testIdentity: [L1:UNIT] CAS01-L1-INITIALIZE-VERSION initializes exactly once after exact CLI version admission
rows.expectedRed: The existing package exports no App Server client, so the selected assertion reports the missing connect behavior.
rows.observableGreen: Exact CLI 0.151.0 is admitted, mismatch rejects before server spawn, initialize is sent once, and initialized follows the successful response.
rows.isolationCleanup: Controlled child exits; no process, stream, listener, or temporary-file delta.

rows.testIdentity: [L1:UNIT] CAS01-L1-CORRELATION resolves concurrent out-of-order responses and fails closed on unmatched IDs
rows.expectedRed: The existing package exports no request-correlation behavior.
rows.observableGreen: Monotonic unique request IDs correlate out-of-order responses; unmatched or duplicate response IDs close the connection and reject pending work.
rows.isolationCleanup: Controlled child and pending requests are closed with zero listeners or timers retained.

rows.testIdentity: [L1:UNIT] CAS01-L1-PROVIDER-ERROR maps provider failures without leaking provider messages or secrets
rows.expectedRed: The existing package has no owned App Server failure vocabulary.
rows.observableGreen: Callers receive an owned method/code failure while raw provider message, data, request payload, environment, and stderr remain absent.
rows.isolationCleanup: Controlled child exits and the failed request is removed from correlation state.

rows.testIdentity: [L1:UNIT] CAS01-L1-INBOUND-BOUNDS exposes notifications and server requests through one bounded feed
rows.expectedRed: The existing package has no bounded App Server inbound feed.
rows.observableGreen: Known and unknown notifications plus server requests retain stable method/id/JSON-safe params; a slow consumer that fills the configured bound closes deterministically.
rows.isolationCleanup: The single feed consumer, waiters, and controlled child are released on return and close.

rows.testIdentity: [L1:UNIT] CAS01-L1-MALFORMED-LIMIT rejects malformed or oversized JSONL without echoing content
rows.expectedRed: The existing package has no App Server trust-boundary parser or byte limit.
rows.observableGreen: Malformed JSON, non-object messages, invalid response envelopes, and oversized lines close with static owned errors that never echo input.
rows.isolationCleanup: Parser/readline/child resources close on every rejection path.

rows.testIdentity: [L1:UNIT] CAS01-L1-CANCEL-EOF distinguishes local cancellation from ambiguous EOF and drains safely
rows.expectedRed: The existing package has no App Server cancellation, tombstone, EOF, or close semantics.
rows.observableGreen: Pre-send abort writes nothing; post-send abort tombstones one late response; EOF rejects written pending calls as ambiguous; close is idempotent and bounded.
rows.isolationCleanup: Abort listeners, timers, tombstones, pending requests, feed waiters, and child process all reach zero.

rows.testIdentity: [L2:INTEGRATION] CAS01-L2-REAL-STREAM starts a real thread and turn and streams delta through terminal completion
rows.expectedRed: The real CLI handshake is independently healthy, but the package exposes no client that can drive the public flow.
rows.observableGreen: Pinned CLI initializes, thread/start and turn/start return stable IDs, the feed observes item delta and completed item, and turn/completed is authoritative.
rows.isolationCleanup: The dedicated temporary CODEX_HOME, thread process, stdio streams, and client child are closed with zero resource delta.

rows.testIdentity: [L2:INTEGRATION] CAS01-L2-REAL-INTERRUPT interrupts a real active turn and closes every owned resource
rows.expectedRed: The real CLI is available, but the package exposes no typed interrupt or bounded cleanup path.
rows.observableGreen: turn/interrupt targets the exact thread/turn, the feed reaches terminal completion without duplicate terminal events, and close leaves no child or stream alive.
rows.isolationCleanup: The dedicated temporary CODEX_HOME and all child descendants, streams, timers, and listeners return to the pre-test inventory.

l3.reason: Protocol-client behavior is fully observable at L1 and the real App Server L2 boundary; actor-facing orchestration begins downstream.
